notes: Story: Damodaran's Sept-2024/Jan-2025 Nvidia story (60% share of the AI chip market, 60% target margin, 20% terminal ROIC) re-based to an AI market that already exceeds Damodaran's Jan-2025 forecast for 2035 ($300bn); Damodaran's two-segment build is replaced by standard Ginzu drivers so every input stays live.

Market-implied: Damodaran's breakeven tool (Dec-2025 Nvidia inputs: 53.01% net margin, 64.44% ROE, 9% cost of equity) needs $546bn of revenue if mature today and $766bn after a five-year wait, at the $5.65trn market cap.
Analyst consensus figures (revenue, price target) are third-party data from S&P Global via StockAnalysis, shown for reference.
